usedFor: When actiTIME logs a new customer, Calendly can answer with “Create Scheduling Link”, a booking link for that account.

bestTemplate.name: “Customer Created” in actiTIME, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer is the clearest moment to offer a meeting, and the action turns it into a booking link.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” in actiTIME fires on every edit, so “Create Scheduling Link” would make a new link each time.
